    i only got to see the 1st half. analysis - napoli setup decent defensively. i liked the pressure, closing bologna down, obtaining possession, generally looking hard to play against due to their numbers close to the man in possession. going forward however, as good as osimhen, kvara, zielinski etc are, they seemed rather uninspired, kvara kept spamming crosses or side passes, and in fact i would say they brute forced the attacks too much. it seems that the manager rates osimhen so highly that all the players try to cross to him or feed him through balls even when he is marked and bot running. this is a system that is easy to break down and they lost many balls this way (on top of not scoring). so i am not surprised it ended 0-0 after the 2nd half
